entry.title: Mini Israel · Azrieli Towers exhibit
entry.note: The 2022 drone footage fixes the approximate pad between the pool path and circular visitor plaza. The square tower is to the northeast of the triangular tower, with the model railway on the visitor-facing southeast side. Verified at all four detail levels in the Earth viewer fixture. The localized terrain grade supports the plinth and exposes the miniature railway. Nearby mapped paths, buildings, pools and land cover remain in the scene. The position and facing come from the drone frame, the north-up aerial view and PMTiles paths. The exhibit has no stand-alone mapped footprint. The current condition and operation of the miniature railway are unverified. A small scene grade levels the raised pad in the default Earth viewer. Hosts with a different elevation datum, terrain profile or a coarse grid may need to provide a level pad at this position. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
